discovery.found_by: find_adaptations.py raise verdict that had never entered the mine/classify/traversal pipeline

why_excluded.finding: Born at or above the boundary. Traversal: 'no boundary-crossing bump in the adaptation's ancestry, declared or resolved'.
why_excluded.detail: 84 pom.xml commits and jackson-databind declared directly, so this had the deepest history of the five and was the most likely to show a crossing. Traversal: no boundary-crossing bump anywhere in the adaptation's ancestry. jackson.version stands at 2.21.4.
why_excluded.pattern: A `raise` verdict proves the client HIT the limit. It does not prove the client CROSSED the boundary. Five open raise candidates were assessed on 2026-08-16 across two breaks -- mmaudet/eu-dss-module, mkarjun/LCS, havochvatten/MSP-Symphony (jackson 2.15) and OussamaLakhdar90/veritas, AxDevv/FAWE-Folia (snakeyaml 1.32) -- and ALL FIVE were born at or above the boundary. They raised a limit that had been there since the day their project started, because their data outgrew the default. Real adaptations to a constraint; not adaptations to a transition.
